overall_summary: The channel shows mixed performance with low overall sample sizes, but 'self respect' and digital/phone interaction hooks (chats, pinned items, clearing history) consistently attract higher views (e.g., 40-41 views) compared to generic emotional topics like 'रात के ख्याल' or 'बेवफाई' (which stalled at lower view counts). Confidence remains low due to small sample sizes and zero engagement metrics, signaling a need for controlled exploration.

winning_patterns.pattern: Digital boundary and chat action hooks
winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'चैट डिलीट करने की हिम्मत' (40 views) and 'Self Respect Status Story' (41 views) outperform traditional emotional poetry.
winning_patterns.action: Focus on tactical smartphone-related actions like clearing chats, muting notifications, or unpinning contacts.

weak_patterns.pattern: Abstract emotional titles and long descriptive hooks
weak_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing heavily on vague nighttime feelings or slow pacing like 'रात के ख्याल और अधूरा इंतजार' generated only 5 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid passive descriptions; anchor every hook in an immediate, physical, modern action.
